events.text: Vehicle proving ground. Your patrol has a Patton, Pegasus and Skulker. The depot stocks all ten vehicles. Take the shuttle east of the depot to the test range on Dustball.
Dustball test range. Enter the control building for a live-fire exercise. The shuttle returns to New Avalon. Each planet retains its own explored map.
The destination formation is blocked. Clear the landing area in the editor.
Exercise complete. The opposition has been defeated. Return to the depot to try another vehicle.
